hazards.effect: unexpected influent composition and unqualified treatment challenge
hazards.detection: source identity state missing or incompatible with approved source matrix
hazards.safe_state: divert source to approved wastewater route; quarantine current batch; no reuse release
hazards.verification: seed unknown-source test; inspect physical source segregation and diversion

hazards.effect: overflow, loss of flow, or unfiltered solids bypass
hazards.detection: measured differential level/pressure or flow deviation; physical inspection
hazards.safe_state: stop feed to process, route to approved drain, service basket
hazards.verification: challenge with measured solids/lint load; verify no bypass or overflow to stormwater

hazards.effect: storage-induced transformation and increased microbial/odour risk
hazards.detection: batch timestamp, timebase validity and temperature history
hazards.safe_state: hold batch; no release; divert or obtain independent quality decision per approved procedure
hazards.verification: seed over-age, stale clock and missing timestamp controls

hazards.effect: barrier performance not established; fouling or breakthrough
hazards.detection: module integrity test, pressure/flow and process-specific admission
hazards.safe_state: isolate cassette; hold product; divert feed
hazards.verification: integrity challenge and post-clean recovery trial with admitted instruments

hazards.effect: disinfection claim unsupported for the batch
hazards.detection: UV system state and independently validated dose/flow/transmittance envelope invalid
hazards.verification: seed low-intensity, lamp fault, fouled sleeve and out-of-range flow tests

hazards.effect: worker exposure and uncontrolled oxidant release
hazards.detection: professionally selected gas detection, ventilation/off-gas interlocks and inspection
hazards.safe_state: de-energise ozone generation, isolate module and follow site emergency procedure
hazards.verification: engineered gas/ventilation functional testing before ozone is introduced

hazards.effect: treated water contains unassessed transformation products
hazards.detection: analytical sampling and validated GAC exhaustion criterion
hazards.safe_state: hold product; replace media or reject train
hazards.verification: feed-specific challenge and byproduct analysis by qualified laboratory

hazards.detection: process history plus source/sample laboratory evidence
hazards.safe_state: hold product; isolate or divert until process restabilised and quality reassessed
hazards.verification: start-up, idling, temperature/load shock and recovery trials

hazards.effect: incomplete treatment or missing process history
hazards.detection: power event/timebase and incomplete cycle receipt
hazards.safe_state: batch remains held; no restart-to-release; require controlled recovery
hazards.verification: cut power during each state and test retained batch identity
negative controls for missing, stale, calibration expired, drift and timebase mismatch

hazards.effect: residual accumulation, overpressure or uncontrolled spill
hazards.safe_state: stop process, isolate energy/source and maintenance lockout
hazards.verification: blocked route tests with contained safe test fluid

hazards.detection: physical design inspection, pressure/backflow test and plumbing professional review
hazards.safe_state: do not commission; physically disconnect/isolate and redesign

invariants: No automated release when any source, storage, process, sample, quality or calibration evidence is unknown, stale, invalid or conflicted.
No potable and reclaimed-water direct pressurised cross-connection in the demonstrator.
No unapproved reject, overflow or backwash discharge route.
Any sensor or controller is a process-control input, not a water-quality certificate.
No installation or operational use before qualified local plumbing/electrical/process review and applicable approvals.
